completeness.why: New getDateWithWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes the applies/mode decision; getNextDate passes its raw skipWeekend/weekendSolve and keeps only its site-only noSkipWeekend guard (allowed), and getUpcomingDates passes its raw config, so both are full; both createScheduleList occurrences still wrap the call in their own `dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate` ternary, so the rule is still decided there (twice), which is the partial anchor.

interface.why: Small, honest signature (date, skipWeekend, solveMode) that parameterises exactly the real variation and lets each caller map its own mode field name, with no speculative options; slightly marred by the template callers redundantly re-checking the flag, which makes the parameter meaningless there.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining duplication is the outer skipWeekend ternary kept verbatim at both createScheduleList sites in server/budget/schedule-template.ts; it is left in plain view, not renamed or reshaped.
